reviews.text: 很有趣的游戏，日本风格的建设小农村到最后盖起一个大城堡，游戏中还能看到各种日本战国时代的小知识，游戏本身画风是可爱类型，和这种真实历史的设定混合起来非常有趣。 一些小建议 UI做的有点不美观，特别是村民举着图标行动的时候非常不好看，我推荐作者参考一款叫《Stonehearth》的游戏，你们的风格非常类似。 敌人1天1次的进攻太频繁了，希望可以由玩家自行设置进攻的频率 我在2015年玩过一款叫《Stonehearth》的游戏，非常好玩，我一直玩到了2023年，这两款游戏画风非常类似，我一下子就想到了当年玩《Stonehearth》的好日子，但遗憾的是《Stonehearth》由于制作组被收购之后已经暂停更新了，那款游戏到最后都没做完，而且优化很糟糕，我希望《Kiritan Castle》能越更新越好玩，我也会一直支持这款游戏 =============================== Very interesting game, Japanese style of building a small rural village to the end of building a big castle, the game can also see a variety of Japanese Warring States era trivia, the game itself is drawn in a cute type of style, and this real history of the setting is very interesting to mix. Some suggestions The UI is a bit unattractive, especially when the villagers hold up the icons for action, it's very unattractive, I recommend the author to refer to a game called Stonehearth, you have a very similar style. Enemies attacking once a day is too frequent, I hope the frequency of attack can be set by the player. I played a game called Stonehearth in 2015 and it was so much fun that I played it until 2023, the two games have very similar styles and I immediately thought of the good old days when I played Stonehearth, but unfortunately Stonehearth has been on a hiatus from updating due to the acquisition of the production team, and that game by the end of the day I hope that Kiritan Castle will be more fun to play and I will always support this game! ================================ 小さな田舎の村を作り、最後に大きな城を建てるという日本的なスタイルで、日本の戦国時代に関する様々な豆知識も紹介されており、ゲーム自体もかわいいタイプのスタイルで描かれており、このような現実の歴史設定とミックスしてとても面白い。 提案 UIが少し魅力的でない。特に村人がアイコンをかざしてアクションをするとき、とても魅力的でない。作者にはストーンアースというゲームを参考にすることをお勧めする。とても似たスタイルを持っている。 敵が1日1回攻撃してくるのは頻度が高すぎる。 2015年にStonehearthというゲームをプレイし、とても面白かったので2023年までプレイしました。この2つのゲームはとてもスタイルが似ていて、Stonehearthをプレイしていた古き良き時代を即座に思い浮かべました。しかし、残念ながらStonehearthは制作チームが買収された後、更新がモラトリアムになったため休止中で、結局そのゲームも休止中です きりたん城がもっと面白くなることを期待していますし、ずっと応援しています！

[h1]这就是沧海遗珠[/h1] 一款画面风格上有点类MC的城堡建设塔防游戏。整体的概念十分独特，它采用了真实的日本地貌，甚至带有经纬度坐标，相当立体且视觉上富有层次。而且玩家可以自由地改变地形，建造各类生产设施、防御设施并攀升科技。目的是建造强大的城堡，抵御敌方每一波次的进攻。专门的新手教程似乎还没做好，但上手不算难但却非常有深度，各类设施都有着独特的机制和作用。此外游戏也支持创意工坊，如果有热度加持，可拓展性很强。但是目前中文有少量文字有“口口”现象，希望制作组给予修复。 [quote]关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42276832//]鸿源鉴游组」 [/url] [/quote] [u][b] 会当逢佳游，始可见鸿源。 [/b][/u]

看似简陋但实际内容丰富，游戏节奏设计也很好，不要被看起来很粗劣的封面骗了，在设计方面绝对是下了苦功夫的，模拟经营方面基本该有的都有，在敌人来袭的情况下搭建自己的城防建造军事建筑出兵来帮助防御，除了数值后期感觉有点难绷，比如打高等级敌人铁炮也只是抽象的几十伤，但是敌人一万血这种情况，不过都可以通过精湛的运营来解决，一枪只有二三十血，穿防只有20%，那我直接出二三十个铁炮照样拿下，玩家的近战部队也可以通过升级变得一样钢筋铁骨，战斗节奏会变得略慢，铁炮感觉很不铁炮外，一切都很ok。 城建方面是典型的日式山城思路，需要通过一层一层的本丸一之丸二之丸等多层城区搭配箭塔高级城楼来不断消耗敌人，打起来非常有防御的快感；要注意的是敌人是可以攀爬悬崖的，所以记得所有想要防御的地区都要好好用墙围好。 期待制作组未来的更新 very good game!
我非常喜欢这个游戏，可以自由的去建一座日本城堡 このゲームが大好きだ！自由に日本のお城を建てられるのが最高だよ。

Quite fun. "Cute" Japanese game themed. Music are good, but the main one during gameplay is very short. RTS -like, basically you have a main building you need to protect and you can build some very basic army to defend it. Melee, range, long range, but no special effect like elemental attack, poison and things like that. There isn't any trap either, and anybody can climb anything (it's slow tho !) so you can't just make a single path with archer on top of it. Well, almost. They don't attack your economy building, only your army-related building but you can mostly leave them outside of the intended paths to avoid spending time repairing them after each fight (repair is automatic btw). During combat you can order your soldier around and try to attack them from behind for extra damage, or just use a bunch of ranged soldier (you might still want some melee to clear walls dropped by the bandits, since it prevent line of sight, protecting them from your ranged soldier). Between combat you try to progress in the tech tree using money, upgrade buildings, make stuff more efficient, and get more food/water/resources for your soldiers. No crash for me, or major bug. However, there is some minor annoyances. Some building have a range around them because they "buff" other buildings; However, most building are bigger than a single block in size, yet the center of the range for the buff isn't in the middle of the building, but instead in his corner. So basically you can buff further away building north/west because it's closer to the corner. It's extra annoying because you can stack each building that buff twice, and there is multiple building that buff the same thing but they have different range (and near all of them have this issue). So it's quite hard/impossible to make something look neat and also min/max the buff. You can mostly free build around, but you are limited in some way (lack of bridges between two elevated point, you need to put staircases nearly everywhere or deal with the very slow climbing speed) You can't mass delete your old army. At some point you really don't need your old archer when you can have elite muskets. The game is missing some translation. You will need to use tools like google translate and copy a screenshot to learn about some building and so on. I'd say it's missing like, 10%? Maybe less. Soldiers sometime get stuck while trying to enter a building (like a tower) and do nothing. It's easy to miss, unless you use the tool in game to reduce the building's size (visual only, doesn't affect gameplay). the tutorial isn't really good at explaining the game, and the UI isn't very intuitive. I was able to figure it, but took me some time just trying things around. At least the easy difficulty IS easy. There isn't many hotkey, so moving your army and building stuff require clicking around all the time. There is no english community. If you don't understand something you will need to figure it yourself. Well, AFAIK the dev(s ?) seems to understand english, but that's a single man (with a job, probably) so maybe don't expect too much on that side. Still, it's cozy and fun. I'll need to give it another try on higher difficulty. I left the comments open in case of, since I don't see many review or message in English. feel free to use this feature.

I've only played this game for a little bit, but I think it has a really cool idea. Basically, it's a base (or castle) building game, with RTS sections. You're usually assigning tasks to build buildings, chop down trees, fish, farm, and other stuff. What makes it interesting is that it has voxels, like Minecraft, so you get to reshape the terrain however you want. That, like everything else, is done by assigning workers, rather than you doing it yourself. Occasionally you get attacked by bandits, and need to mobilize your troops. Thankfully (IMO), you don't have to micromanage at all. You don't have to search for an idle worker and say "you, go build this," or something like that. Instead, it's all done with a management screen where you hire workers, then assign the number of workers to each type of job. Workers will automatically take on an available job. So, for example, once you start a new construction project, a construction worker will rush over as soon as it can. Battles, too, don't require much micromanagement. It has a simple UI to form all of your selected troops into a line, circle, or triangle, to match your defensive/offensive needs. Right now, the biggest problem is that a lot of text is still untranslated and will show in its original Japanese. But that's understandable since it's still in Early Access. If you're planning on picking this game up, for your first castle I'd recommend focusing on building farms and water sources first, and assigning several workers to those. Then, once you have barracks to house troops, assign a bunch of workers to deliver food and water to the troops. Build roads so that they can deliver quickly. Otherwise, you'll have starving and dehydrated troops who can't fight. Overall, it's a pretty relaxing game, and it's fun to just watch the workers run around doing their tasks. I recommend it as a game for a simple, stress-free experience. [h2]Edit[/h2] After playing the game a bit more, I've realized that this game is way more detailed than I first thought. Soldiers have different levels of defense for front, side, and back. Different types of soil have different fertility and defense bonuses. [i]Each block apparently has its own temperature.[/i] It's pretty impressive IMO.
